arxiv-2105-04041.title: Lyapunov–Krasovskii functionals for some classes of nonlinear time delay systems
arxiv-2105-04041.creator: Gerson Portilla, Irina V. Alexandrova, Sabine Mondié
arxiv-2105-04041.description: Abstract In this contribution, we study an homogeneous class of nonlinear time delay systems with time-varying perturbations. Using the Lyapunov-Krasovskii approach, we introduce a functional that leads to perturbation conditions matching those obtained previously in the Razumikhin framework. The functionals are applied to the estimation of the domain of attraction and of the system solutions. An illustrative example is given.

arxiv-2106-10766.title: Learning to Track Object Position through Occlusion
arxiv-2106-10766.creator: Satyaki Chakraborty, Martial Hebert
arxiv-2106-10766.description: Abstract Occlusion is one of the most significant challenges encountered by object detectors and trackers. While both object detection and tracking has received a lot of attention in the past, most existing methods in this domain do not target detecting or tracking objects when they are occluded.

arxiv-2109-02164.title: Estimation of cluster functionals for regularly varying time series: runs estimators
arxiv-2109-02164.creator: Youssouph Cissokho, Rafał Kulik
arxiv-2109-02164.description: Abstract Cluster indices describe extremal behaviour of stationary time series. We consider runs estimators of cluster indices. Using a modern theory of multivariate, regularly varying time series, we obtain central limit theorems under conditions that can be easily verified for a large class of models. In particular, we show that blocks and runs estimators have the same limiting variance.

arxiv-2207-06925.title: Adjacencies on random ordering polytopes and flow polytopes
arxiv-2207-06925.creator: Jean-Paul Doignon, Kota Saito
arxiv-2207-06925.description: Abstract The Multiple Choice Polytope (MCP) is the prediction range of a random utility model due to Block and Marschak (1960). Fishburn (1998) offers a nice survey of the findings on random utility models at the time. A complete characterization of the MCP is a remarkable achievement of Falmagne (1978).

arxiv-2209-03331.title: Wannier Excitons Confined in Hexagonal Boron Nitride Triangular Quantum Dots
arxiv-2209-03331.creator: M. F. C. Martins Quintela, N. M. R. Peres
arxiv-2209-03331.description: Abstract With the ever-growing interest in quantum computing, understanding the behaviour of excitons in monolayer quantum dots has become a topic of great relevance. In this paper, we consider a Wannier exciton confined in a triangular quantum dot of hexagonal Boron Nitride.

arxiv-2305-16682.title: Sharpend Cosine Similarity based Neural Network for Hyperspectral Image Classification
arxiv-2305-16682.creator: Muhammad Ahmad
arxiv-2305-16682.description: Abstract Hyperspectral Image Classification (HSIC) is a difficult task due to high inter and intra-class similarity and variability, nested regions, and overlapping. 2D Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) emerged as a viable network whereas, 3D CNNs are a better alternative due to accurate classification. However, 3D CNNs are highly computationally complex due to their volume and spectral dimensions.

arxiv-2504-02864.title: The Material Contracts Corpus
arxiv-2504-02864.creator: Peter Adelson, Julian Nyarko
arxiv-2504-02864.description: Abstract This paper introduces the Material Contracts Corpus (MCC), a publicly available dataset comprising over one million contracts filed by public companies with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) between 2000 and 2023. The MCC facilitates empirical research on contract design and legal language, and supports the development of AI-based legal tools.

arxiv-2508-05072.title: One-sided composite cavity on an optical nanocapillary fiber Journal: opticajournal
arxiv-2508-05072.creator: Srinu Gadde, Jelba John, and Ramachandrarao Yalla*
arxiv-2508-05072.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Srinu Gadde, Jelba John, and Ramachandrarao Yalla*. We numerically report a one-sided cavity on an optical nanocapillary fiber (NCF) using a composite cavity. The composite cavity is formed by combining an optical NCF and an asymmetric defect mode grating. We design the cavity to realize the maximum channeling efficiency of up to ∼ 80 % \sim 80\% into one-sided NCF-guided modes while operating from under- to critical- and over-coupling regimes.

arxiv-2512-05316.description: Abstract Information theory is introduced in this lecture note with a particular emphasis on its relevance to algebraic coding theory. pmc-11529525.title: Type I MET inhibitors cooperate with PD-1 blockade to promote rejection of hepatocellular carcinoma

MET plays key roles in both HCC tumorigenesis and immunosuppressive conditioning; however, inhibition of MET causes upregulation of PD-ligand 1 (PD-L1) suggesting the use of these inhibitors in the context of PD-1 blockade.
